prompt: As of 1st August 2024, How much younger is the current youngest US House Representative than the American folk hero who died at the Alamo when they were elected to the US House of Representatives?
answer:
As of **August 1, 2024**, the youngest House representative was **Maxwell Frost**, who was elected at age **25** (25 years, 295 days).

The folk hero **Davy Crockett** was elected to the U.S. House in 1827 at approximately age **40**.

Therefore, **Maxwell Frost was about 15 years younger than Davy Crockett was when Crockett was elected**—more precisely, roughly **14 years and 10–11 months younger**, depending on the exact election dates used.
